tools.name: mc_set_version
tools.description: Set the active Minecraft version for subsequent operations. Must be called before using other tools, or provide a version parameter to each tool call.

tools.name: mc_list_versions
tools.description: List all available Minecraft versions and their initialization status. Use this to see which versions are ready to use.

tools.name: mc_search
tools.description: Search for Minecraft or Fabric API classes, methods, or fields by name pattern. Returns matching results with their full names and source locations.

query.description: The search query - class, method, or field name (or partial name)

type.description: Optional: filter by type (class, method, or field)

version.description: Optional: Minecraft version to use (e.g., "1.21.1"). If not provided, uses the active version set by mc_set_version.

tools.name: mc_get_class
tools.description: Get the full decompiled source code for a Minecraft or Fabric API class. Also returns class hierarchy (extends, implements) and field/method signatures.

version.description: Optional: Minecraft version to use (e.g., "1.21.1"). If not provided, uses the active version set by mc_set_version.

tools.name: mc_get_method
tools.description: Get the source code for a specific method in a class, with surrounding context. Useful for understanding method implementation details.

version.description: Optional: Minecraft version to use (e.g., "1.21.1"). If not provided, uses the active version set by mc_set_version.

tools.name: mc_find_refs
tools.description: Find callers (who calls this method) or callees (what this method calls) using the callgraph database. Useful for understanding code dependencies.

methodName.description: Method name to find references for

direction.description: callers = who calls this method, callees = what this method calls

version.description: Optional: Minecraft version to use (e.g., "1.21.1"). If not provided, uses the active version set by mc_set_version.

tools.name: mc_list_classes
tools.description: List all classes under a specific package path. Returns class names and their source locations. Use this to discover classes in a package hierarchy.

packagePath.description: Package path to list classes from (e.g., "net.minecraft.client", "net.minecraft.world.entity"). Matches exact package and all subpackages.

version.description: Optional: Minecraft version to use (e.g., "1.21.1"). If not provided, uses the active version set by mc_set_version.

tools.name: mc_list_packages
tools.description: List all available packages. Optionally filter by namespace (minecraft or fabric). Use this to discover package structure.

namespace.description: Optional: filter by namespace (minecraft or fabric)

version.description: Optional: Minecraft version to use (e.g., "1.21.1"). If not provided, uses the active version set by mc_set_version.

tools.name: mc_find_hierarchy
tools.description: Find classes that extend (subclasses) or implement (implementors) a given class or interface. Useful for understanding class inheritance relationships.

className.description: Fully qualified class or interface name (e.g., "net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity", "net.minecraft.world.item.Item")

direction.description: subclasses = classes that extend this class, implementors = classes that implement this interface

version.description: Optional: Minecraft version to use (e.g., "1.21.1"). If not provided, uses the active version set by mc_set_version.
